decisions.rationale: NOA 2025 ($139,661) and current pay stub (about $145k annualized, YTD consistent) support the stated $145,000.
Appraised value of $376,000 is about 10% below the $420,000 purchase price.
No employment letter is on file; the borrower note says it will follow.
Worksheet GDS about 32% and TDS about 37% with score 745 are within limits.
